CMR.note: Online pre-enrolment by one-time code is enrolment, not an identity authentication service.
Birth certificates are only documents supplied by the applicant; no register link stated.
Two presidential decrees of 28 February 2025 are named, not a law; no statement of a law in force.
Nothing on disability access to digital services.
Nothing on government payments to people.
Card is for adults from 18; no number at birth.
Names the police as issuer and national production centres, but not who operates, maintains or owns the system platform.
No public register keyed on the ID number named.

facts.fact: The national police (DGSN) brochure says national identity cards are issued after online pre-enrolment and physical biometric enrolment, produced within 48 hours at centres in Yaounde, Douala and Garoua, under decrees signed on 28 February 2025.

CMR.note: Cards follow ICAO Doc 9303 and ISO/IEC 7810, but the document states no study-relevant adoption or certification fact I can class.
No survey share of adults with accounts.
Police run ID enrolment only; nothing on the police study's subject.
Nothing on local civil registration offices.

facts.fact: The DGSN brochure lists Yoomee, MTN Mobile Money and Orange Money as ways to pay the identity-card fee online.
facts.system: Mobile money (Yoomee, MTN Mobile Money, Orange Money)

systems.system: Mobile money (Yoomee, MTN Mobile Money, Orange Money)

facts.fact: The DGSN brochure says the 10,000 FCFA stamp duty for the national identity card is paid online at pre-enrolment.
facts.system: idcam.cm online payment of stamp duty
